verdict.rationale: v0's evidence shows AI-generated insight limited to diagnosing deployment/build failures from logs and auto-applying fixes, and 'planning tasks' as it builds — a narrow, code/ops-focused form of insight rather than broad AI-generated insights/suggestions from a user's own data (e.g., business, usage, or analytics data). Missing for 10: evidence of analyzing general user data (not just build logs) for insights, dashboards or analytics-style suggestions, and independent corroboration of this insight capability.
